Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Experience: 5+ years
Location: Hyderabad, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
Mandatory Skills:
- Go
- Apache Kafka
Good to have:
- AWS
- Kubernetes

Responsibilities:
- Design, develop and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go, ensuring low-latency and high-availability.
- Build and operate event-driven systems and streaming pipelines leveraging Apache Kafka for real-time data processing and integration.
- Collaborate with product, frontend and QA teams to translate requirements into scalable backend architectures and APIs.
- Own service lifecycle: code, review, deploy, monitor and troubleshoot production services; implement robust observability and alerting.
- Mentor junior engineers, conduct technical reviews, and drive best practices in code quality, testing and documentation.
- Participate in capacity planning, performance tuning and incident response; propose improvements to reduce operational overhead.
- Work with cloud and platform teams to containerize services and integrate with CI/CD pipelines; optionally contribute to AWS and Kubernetes operational playbooks.
